echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Maximizes the 38% Resonance Skill DMG buff she hands the next Resonator via Outro, plus Energy Regen for her rotations.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: For a damage-focused Lumi or double-DPS setups; use the normal Tempest Mephis if you lack Rinascita access.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds + Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: Mix of Energy Regen and Electro DMG while farming a full 5-piece set.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; high — Prydwen notes she is very energy-hungry and needs ER investment plus energy-feeding teammates to fund her 125-energy Liberation
build.fast_path: Fast path: Lustrous Razor (Discord as the 4-star rotation pick) + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Run CRIT Rate/DMG on the 4-cost, Electro DMG (or Energy Regen) on 3-costs, ATK% on 1-costs — her job is feeding the next Resonator a 38% Resonance Skill DMG Outro, so Concerto speed and Liberation uptime matter as much as her own damage.

ranked_weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's #1: Energy Regen plus stacking Resonance Liberation DMG, letting her cast Liberation every rotation. A standard-banner 5-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Ages of Harvest
ranked_weapons.note: Prydwen's top damage pick: 12% Attribute DMG and 24% Resonance Skill DMG on Intro/Skill casts. Jinhsi's signature, not hers.

ranked_weapons.name: Verdant Summit
ranked_weapons.note: Jiyan's signature: big CRIT DMG stat plus Heavy Attack DMG after skills — strong on her Basic-Attack-centric kit.

ranked_weapons.name: Discord
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star for rotations: restores Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill, speeding up her Outro.

ranked_weapons.name: Waning Redshift
ranked_weapons.note: Event 4-star: grants Resonance Energy and ATK on Resonance Skill cast. Free last-resort: Broadblade of Voyager.

stat_priorities.note: Balance CRIT Rate and DMG; her Forte damage scales mostly off Basic Attack DMG.
Electro DMG standard; swap a 3-cost to Energy Regen if her Liberation uptime suffers.

profile.role_note: Electro Hybrid buffer with a dual-stance ranged/melee kit; her Outro grants the next Resonator 38% Resonance Skill DMG for 10s, making her a natural partner for Skill-scaling carries like Hsin and Changli.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A handy 4-star Hybrid who hands Resonance Skill-scaling carries a 38% damage amp — niche but real value if you run Hsin or Changli, not a pull priority on her own.

sources.record: Wuthering Waves Character Tier List for Version 3.7

members.name: Lumi
members.note: Sub-DPS; cycles Yellow/Red Light stances for Sparks and Liberation, then Outros the 38% Resonance Skill DMG buff.

members.name: Hsin
members.note: Main DPS in Unison Resonance Mode; scales heavily with Resonance Skill DMG.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Team-wide buffs and healing; Verina or Baizhi can substitute.

teams.name: Premium: Hsin + Lumi + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens with Liberation and Outros to Hsin, who builds Forte and bursts. Lumi then cycles her stances to charge Sparks, casts her Liberation, and Outros back to Hsin with the 38% Resonance Skill DMG amp.

members.name: Lumi
members.note: Sub-DPS; benefits from Changli's field time while her Outro boosts Changli's skill-heavy combos.

members.name: Changli
members.note: Fusion carry who benefits from Lumi's 38% Resonance Skill DMG Outro buff.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing, team ATK buff, and DMG Deepen for both damage dealers.

teams.name: Alternative: Changli + Lumi + Verina
teams.rotation: Verina heals and buffs, Lumi builds Sparks and Outros for the 38% Resonance Skill DMG buff, then Changli takes an extended window spending both buffs on her skill-heavy combos.

tier_badge.label: Situational
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates her Overall B as a Sub-DPS (B in Tower of Adversity, C in Whimpering Wastes); Beebom's 3.7 tier list places her in C — a usable niche Hybrid buffer, outclassed in serious endgame teams.
